The '''''Perspicacity''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that was used by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Beld Yulan]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jarrow Rusher]] served aboard the ship for a [[Time/Legends|time]].
